description:
Prerequisite: approved capability/API contract and adapter metadata source in zaq-h2i.3.1. Functional scope: one pure Channels resolver producing the unchanged TransportRequirements struct from a capability snapshot and actual selected outbound connection; one shared ConnectorConfig normalization/validation implementation. Persist integer bytes/count and configuration policy only. Do not acquire files, plan, send or wire delivery/history. For later IMAP replies caller must supply selected SMTP config. Resolve once per attempt in the later integration, not in this issue.

Action reuse: local-only pure derived domain operation; reuse existing capability semantics and Settings projections; no Action, endpoint, tool exposure, Repo, runtime config, or bridge-specific requirements construction. Normalize/validate in shared pure config code that Engine and BO may use without crossing into Channels directly. Preserve struct file/test byte-for-byte. Public result/error and field definitions require prerequisite approval.

Tests before code: inspect existing SettingsTest and TransportRequirementsTest first. Extend the owning suites with new describe blocks, preserving issue 1 assertions and fixtures. A new resolver suite is justified only if responsibility cannot fit a cohesive existing suite; no duplicate setup or copied reference tests. Original example/property tests must fail for missing behavior before implementation. Cover all transport limit states, valid/malformed/blank inputs, exact MB/byte round trips, required vs optional constraints, fixed/configurable ceiling invariants, native/fallback/unsupported, transfer mode/count requirements, threads vs attachment edits, policy default/false, deterministic pure outcomes and zero send/acquisition effects. Control no global state. No mocks needed for pure inputs.

Docs: focused public docs/types, Channels guide ownership and resolver lifecycle/errors; shared configuration units. Validate via mix q and isolated suites, review diff and Action reuse. Do not run precommit, commit or push.
title: [zaq-h2i.3] Implement shared file normalization and requirements resolver
